items.name: research-methodology
items.title: Research Methodology
items.description: Choose and justify a research design for each research question: controlled experiment, quasi-experiment, case study, survey, interview study, design science, action research, or mixed methods, with the data collection, sampling, analysis, ethics, and validity threats each entails, and write the method chapter's design section from the choice. Use when moving from research questions to a study plan, when a supervisor asks how the question will be answered, or when reviewers say the method cannot support the claims.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
